request.prompt: A brand sonic logo (audio mnemonic) for the end card of a premium Indian TV commercial, simple enough to hum after one listen, like a famous telecom signature tune. C major. Three rising notes in a short-short-long rhythm, G, C, E, played on warm felt piano doubled by a soft celesta; the long third note blooms into a warm C major chord with lush strings and a low piano root note; short clean tail into silence. Hopeful, trustworthy, premium, modern. Instrumental only. No drums.

headers.access-control-allow-methods: POST, PATCH, OPTIONS, DELETE, GET, PUT
